urls.title: Websites or domains
urls.description: One per line: bare domains (acme.com) or full URLs. Duplicates are removed automatically. You're only charged for domains where a contact is found.

maxPagesPerDomain.title: Max pages per domain
maxPagesPerDomain.description: Pages scanned per domain: the home page first, then contact, about, impressum and footer-linked pages. 3 covers most sites.

concurrency.title: Parallel domains
concurrency.description: How many domains to process at the same time. 20 is fast and polite. Lower it if a site rate-limits you.

chargeOnlyHits.title: Only charge for domains with contacts
chargeOnlyHits.description: Charge only for domains where at least one contact was found.

validateMx.title: Validate MX records
validateMx.description: After syntax checks, look up an MX record for each email domain. Lookups time out quickly, are cached for the run, and never call a paid verification API. Turn this off to skip DNS.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default because most sites don't need it. Turn on the Apify proxy if many domains block or time out.
